instruction: Create a scatter (XY) chart showing the relationship between Sales (X-axis) and COGS (Y-axis) in a new sheet. Title the chart "Sales vs COGS Analysis".

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a scatter (XY) chart with title 'Sales vs COGS Analysis' in a new sheet. Similar difficulty to original but different chart type (scatter instead of column). Evaluator verifies: 1) Chart type is ScatterChartType, 2) Title is correct, 3) Chart is in a new sheet.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: Instruction requires 'Sales (X-axis) and COGS (Y-axis)' but evaluator does NOT verify which data columns are used for the axes
The metric only checks chart type, title, and new sheet location - missing verification of data series mapping
An agent could create a scatter chart with ANY two columns (e.g., Week vs Price), title it correctly, and pass verification even though it doesn't use Sales and COGS
Chart type verification is correct: ScatterChartType is appropriate for scatter (XY) charts
Title verification is correct: checks for exact match 'Sales vs COGS Analysis'
New sheet verification is correct: properly checks chart is not in Sheet1
Postconfig is appropriate: saves file to persist chart state
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add data series verification to check_chart_properties__2c525de8: extract chart.series data and verify X-axis uses 'Sales' column and Y-axis uses 'COGS' column
Use openpyxl chart.series[0].xVal and chart.series[0].yVal to access the cell references for X and Y data
Verify that the referenced cells contain data from columns with headers 'Sales' and 'COGS' (or verify column indices match the expected columns)
Add expected values for x_column and y_column in the expected rules to enable this verification
Alternative: Use openpyxl to read the chart's data references and match them against expected column names/indices
